svg.title: Gameplay finished-plan test coverage audit
svg.desc: Coverage audit showing implemented milestones, the missing Day 48 test that was added, validation results, and the separate Git LFS asset blocker affecting RoleBattle tests.
svg.text: Gameplay Expansion · finished-plan test coverage audit

✕ Day 48 had 6 of 7 named native cases

✕ Day 41 tests failed before assertions on macOS

Day 49 ownership coverage also lacked an explicit no-partial-lease assertion.
audit → repair → prove

✓ Foreign-event coverage spans all three verbs
Clear death, escort arrival, and relay ownership reject stale runs.
✓ Day 49 preparation is proven atomic
Client replay and unavailable second civilian leave no partial lease.
✓ Day 41 fixtures resolve the macOS temp alias
